summary: El Trilogy is the 17th album by trumpeter Dave Douglas, released on the BMG label in 2001. It contains music commissioned to accompany performances by the Trisha Brown Dance Company. The album is performed by Douglas together with Greg Cohen, Mark Feldman, Guy Klucevsek, Gregory Tardy and Susie Ibarra.
one_line: El Trilogy is Dave Douglas's 2001 BMG album of music commissioned for Trisha Brown Dance Company performances.
